# pantechdynamics_cloud_providers (Data Source)

Lists every cloud Pantech Migrate can connect with a pantechdynamics_cloud_connection, how Pantech reads it, and whether a scan reads its spend and its people.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pantechdynamics_cloud_providers" "all" {}

# The clouds this platform can connect now, and how Pantech reads each.
output "available_clouds" {
  value = { for p in data.pantechdynamics_cloud_providers.all.providers : p.slug => p.access if p.available }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "cloud_providers".
- `providers` (Attributes List) The clouds, in the order the API lists them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--providers))

<a id="nestedatt--providers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `providers`

Read-Only:

- `access` (String) "federated": Pantech reads the cloud with short-lived tokens it signs and the cloud trusts. "agent": the customer runs the Pantech Migrate agent, which keeps the read-only token on their machine.
- `available` (Boolean) Whether this platform can connect it now.
- `cost_readable` (Boolean) Whether a scan reads the source's spend.
- `name` (String) The cloud's name.
- `people_readable` (Boolean) Whether a scan lists the people with access.
- `slug` (String) The value for a pantechdynamics_cloud_connection's cloud, such as "aws", "gcp" or "hetzner".
